Hi all —

Quick technical + packaging note: 

Hosted (recommended to start):
- Latency: ~50–120ms p95 for single-turn generative calls in our hosted multi-tenant environment (depends on model selection).
- Scale: automatic horizontal autoscaling for spikes; prefix caching helps with repeat prompts.
- Onboarding: fastest (API keys + VPC peering optional).

Dedicated (reserved capacity):
- Latency: consistent low p95 (~30–80ms) due to dedicated GPU pools and reserved throughput.
- Commit model: reserved vGPU or token commitments; better unit economics for sustained usage.
- Use when you need isolation, predictable tail latency, or have regulatory constraints.

Private (VPC / on-prem):
- Use only for strict data residency or compliance requirements. Onboarding and ops overhead higher; typically 8–12 week project.

Notes for Procurement: 
- Discounts tied to committed spend tiers; we can provide an appendix to the MSA listing exact thresholds and SLAs.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace purchase is possible for Hosted SaaS; pricing on the marketplace can differ if we need to bake in marketplace fees — we can produce a marketplace SKU that mirrors direct contract pricing where required.

Happy to run a 30‑min technical q&a with Acme infra/infra procurement to validate latency SLOs and deployment options.

Thanks,
